goal: AI privacy and child protections in backend/routers/ai.py and backend/services/.

features_delivered: PII Sanitization before External AI Invocation: Pre-invocation regex scrubbing redacting student phone numbers ([REDACTED_PHONE]), email addresses ([REDACTED_EMAIL]), and school/street addresses ([REDACTED_ADDRESS]) before prompts reach LLM APIs.

Negative Abuse Guardrails: Intercepts combined student PII in raw prompts across /api/v1/ai/tutor, /api/v1/ai/qa, and streaming endpoints, ensuring external models never receive plaintext student identity or location.
PII Sanitization in Database Logs: Stored AIMessage.content and AIJob.prompt rows have personal data scrubbed, conversation title auto-generation is sanitized, and pii_redacted flag is recorded.

Age-Appropriate Content Filters: Inbound minor student prompts asking about self-harm, weapons/bombs, illicit drugs, or adult/sexual topics are blocked without invoking external LLMs, returning age-appropriate educational guidance.
Outbound Response Safety Sanitizer: AI answers are passed through apply_content_safety_filter() for minors, replacing unsafe keywords with age-appropriate alternatives.

Zero Training on Minor Student Messages: Messages from minor students (<18 or unverified) are flagged training_allowed=False unless verified guardian consent is present (via User.guardian_consent or ClassMember.guardian_consent).
Training Dataset Export Gating: export_conversations_for_training() strictly excludes 100% of messages from minors lacking guardian consent.
Minimal Conversation Retention: Automated enforce_ai_conversation_retention() purges conversations of minor students older than 30 days and cascades to AIMessage and AIJob records.
Right to Erasure: Supports DELETE /api/v1/ai/conversations/{id} and complete history purge via purge_user_ai_history().
